translation.name: Biblica® Se aɖeke mebla Biblia zazã o Agbenya La™

content.text: O! Mawu, tsɔ wò afia nyui tsotso do na fia la,
kple wò dzɔdzɔenyenye na fiavi la.
Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu na wò dukɔ la le dzɔdzɔenyenye me,
eye wòatso afia nyui na ame siwo ƒe dzi gbã la.
Towo atsɔ kesinɔnuwo vɛ na wò dukɔ,
eye togbɛwo atsɔ dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe kutsetse vɛ na wo.
Aʋli ame siwo ƒe dzi gbã la ta,
axɔ na hiãtɔwo ƒe viwo,
eye wòagbã ameteɖetola la nyanyanya.
Zi ale si ɣe kple ɣleti li la,
anɔ te le dzidzimewo katã me.
Anɔ abe tsidzadza ɖe anyigba si dzi woƒo gbe le
kple agbafie si dza ɖe anyigba hede tsii ene.
Ame dzɔdzɔewo ayi ŋgɔ le eƒe ɣeyiɣiwo me,
eye kesinɔnuwo ado agbogbo va se ɖe esime ɣleti magaɖi o.
Aɖu fia tso atsiaƒu ƒe go sia dzi ayi go kemɛ dzi,
tso tɔsisi to ase ɖe anyigba la ƒe mlɔenuwo ke.
Dukɔ siwo le gbegbe la ade ta agu nɛ,
eye eƒe futɔwo aɖuɖɔ ʋuʋudedi.
Tarsis fia kple didiƒe ƒutatɔwo ahe adzɔ vɛ nɛ,
eye Sieba kple Seba fiawo atsɔ nunanawo vɛ nɛ.
Fiawo katã ade ta agu nɛ,
eye dukɔwo katã asubɔe,
elabena aɖe hiãtɔ si le avi fam
kple wɔmenɔ si xɔnametɔ aɖeke meli na o.
Akpɔ nublanui na ame gblɔewo kple hiãtɔwo,
eye wòaɖe ame dahewo tso ku me.
Aɖe wo le teteɖeanyi kple ŋutasesẽ me,
elabena woƒe ʋu xɔ asi le eŋkume.
Fia la nenɔ agbe tegbee!
Wonetsɔ Seba sika nɛ.
Amewo nedo gbe ɖa ɖe eta ɖaa,
eye wòayra ŋkeke blibo la.
Bli nedo agbogbo ɖe anyigba la katã dzi;
eye neʋã ɖe togbɛwo katã dzi.
Blitiawo netri abe Lebanontɔwo ene,
eye woanɔ abe gbe le gbedzi ene.
Eƒe ŋkɔ nenɔ anyi ɖaa,
eye nenɔ anyi zi ale si ɣe le keklẽm.
Woayra dukɔwo katã to eya amea dzi,
eye woayɔe be yayratɔ.
Woakafu Yehowa Mawu,
Israel ƒe Mawu la,
eya ame si ko wɔa nu dzɔatsuwo.
Woakafu eƒe ŋkɔ si ŋu ŋutikɔkɔe
le la tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me;
eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe neyɔ anyigba blibo la dzi.
Esiawo wu Yese ƒe vi, David ƒe gbedodoɖawo nu.
